reviewed_by: Codex side chat parent ownership review
reason: Core now discovers side chats by parent conversation and retains them until explicit close. The UI displays a side chat only beside its parent, restores it on return and reload, and clears a stale side-chat URL on another conversation. The selected backend file covers discovery, expiry, and discard; the focused unit file covers ownership selection; the existing side-chat Playwright entries cover navigation, draft retention, and durable real-Core behavior. A comment in chat.py classifies an existing expected missing-goal handler for the repository diagnostic audit. In api.py, unarchiving uses the already loaded chat ID so mypy can prove it is a string. Neither CI repair changes behavior.
exclusions: Native code is unchanged. Unrelated backend and UI journeys and full suites are excluded; the chat.py and api.py CI repairs do not change behavior. Mocked WebKit full reload is excluded because it bypasses this fixture's API routes; the selected production real-Core journey checks reload. Browser and device coverage applies only to the side-chat journey.
